title: Citation Existence Verdict
description: DISCOVER deterministic gate-helper artifact (absorption wave 1; ARS three-state pattern). Output of tools/citation_existence.build_existence_verdict: every external reference is looked up live and lands in exactly one of verified / not_found / lookup_error / skipped. R3 C2 (2026-08-07; director-tightened 2026-08-07): the verdict is three states, checked in this order — BLOCK when any ref is CONFIRMED not_found (fabricated-citation signal; checked FIRST and unconditionally, even alongside an unrelated lookup_error or zero verified refs elsewhere in the batch — grounding is never relaxed for a confirmed fabrication); else UNVERIFIED when no refs were given or nothing was genuinely verified while at least one lookup errored (no real check happened); else PASS. lookup_error alone, alongside at least one genuine verified ref and no confirmed not_found, is a warning, never a block (offline-safe) and never silently counted as verified. Complements (never replaces) the structural citation_integrity_verdict gate: that gate checks anchoring/contradiction against the claim_evidence_map; this one checks the refs exist in the world.

checked.description: One entry per input ref, in input order. Deterministic given the same transport answers.

detail.description: Human-readable lookup evidence (source that answered, match ratio, or the error). Never inlined paper content.

verdict.description: Checked in this order — BLOCK iff n_not_found > 0 (unconditional, checked first); else UNVERIFIED iff checked is empty or (n_verified==0 and n_lookup_error>0); else PASS.

violations.description: One line per confirmed-missing ref. Non-empty iff verdict is BLOCK.

warnings.description: One line per lookup_error ref (could not check; absence unconfirmed).
